name: delete_registered_plugin
description: Resolves install_generated_plugin's 'already registered' conflict the other way: deletes this plugin's local dev store registration entirely (and the hub's own on-disk files for it), then clears the locally-known nsid so the next install_generated_plugin call registers it fresh. Does not uninstall the plugin if it's currently installed -- call delete_plugin for that, separately, if needed. Requires a locally-known nsid; fails if there isn't one. This is a real, permanent change on the hub, performed through this assistant. Code-enforced two-call confirm, same shape as delete_plugin: call once without `confirmed` (or `confirmed: false`) to resolve the registration and see what would be deleted -- this does not delete anything. Only call again with `confirmed: true` after the developer has explicitly agreed to delete it -- never speculatively. The system independently verifies the developer's literal next reply was exactly the word YES (all caps) before honoring confirmed: true, regardless of what this call's own confirmed argument says.

location.description: The 'location' a generate_plugin_scaffold/list_generated_plugins call returned, identifying which generated plugin's registration to delete.

confirmed.description: Leave unset (or false) for the first call, which only previews the delete and performs no side effects. Set to true only on a follow-up call, only after the developer has explicitly agreed to delete it.
